scope: Exactly one bounded forensic Jan-Apr 2025 reuse of already inspected development; no fresh economic or prospective alpha claim, no reuse of reserved final seed data.
research_question: Identify the realized most-profitable one-contract 1-3 day put/call opportunities among contracts selectable using D quote, and test whether fixed D-only technical and option IV features forecast them.
diagnostic_oracle: Ex-post selects among feasible D contracts using D+1 ask and D+2 bid; solely descriptive, excluded from strategies and model input. For market quote proxy not actual fills.
signal_schedule: Use same P1 every second eligible Jan-Apr session, decision D quote & D-3 SPY return, IOC modeled at D+1 EOD, exit at D+2 EOD (elapsed <=72h). No overlapping positions.
fill: D freeze ID and ask-based ceiling=min(0.45,round(D_ask*1.20+0.03,2)), next day pay ask+.01+0.65 fee, reject if above ceiling or one-lot full-risk exceeds 0.25% capital; close D+2 at bid-.01 less 0.65. Missing exit quote write down to zero.

new_rules.IV_DISCOUNT_TREND: Buy same 3-day SPY momentum side only if trailing 20-session SPY realized vol >=1.2*same-day selected option IV; otherwise CASH.
new_rules.REVERSAL_ABS_2PCT: Buy opposite 3-session move side only if abs 3-day SPY return >= 2%; else CASH.

analysis_endpoints: upper-bound ex-post oracle gross and concentration
causal strategy cashflow, DD, worst day, monthly consistency and best-trade removal
negative as well as positive results
source_quality_limitations: Public quote mirror, provenance not independently authenticated
Date-only EOD quotes not broker executions
SPY American physical settlement, N10 P0 XSP European model not equivalent
falsifiers: Causal strategy not beating CASH after all costs
Ex-post oracle positive while no same-day feature predictor works
Quote timestamp does not establish causal EOD clocks
prohibited: future quote used as candidate selection
